plugins.name: switch-mods
plugins.description: Type /amods to open a panel that switches every installed plugin and mod on or off. Works in the terminal and the desktop app.

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: Catches a long, messy prompt, asks only the questions that change the outcome (each with a default), then fills the prompt box with a clear brief: the job, the why, the guardrails, what done means and the assumptions, plus working rules for Claude.

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: A band above your prompt, slim or detailed: usage left in the 5-hour and 7-day windows with reset times and a pace warning before you run out, how full the context is, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold. Works in the terminal and desktop app, light or dark.

plugins.name: sess-handoff
plugins.description: Writes a detailed handoff prompt of the whole chat at 250k tokens, when the prompt cache goes cold, or when you type sess-handoff. Waits for subagents to finish, asks before opening a fresh chat seeded with it, and can copy it for a teammate.
